name: effort-picker
description: Sets each Claude request's effort level from the task, not the prompt: Claude picks it once it understands the work, and helpers get a level per job.

baseline.title: Starting effort for each prompt
baseline.description: The level every automatic prompt starts at, before Claude picks one for the task.

staleDays.title: Remind me when the effort rules are this many days old
staleDays.description: Show a reminder to check for a plugin update once the effort rules were last checked against Anthropic's docs more than this many days ago. 0 turns it off.
